purpose: Source-backed directory MVP candidates, not launch approval or measured SEO opportunities.
verification_limits: Source counts, API facets and official population statistics are distinguished below.
No full candidate dataset was imported or independently deduplicated in this review.
Documented fields do not mean that every record contains them.
All qualified_entry_count values remain null and all launch_ready values false.
No search volumes, traffic forecasts, affiliate contracts or revenue estimates were verified.

projects.name: Badestellen und Badegewaesser Deutschland

source_count.scope: Germany, reported bathing waters in season 2025

projects.deduplication: Use bathing-water identifier; retain annual observations separately. Count one water per profile, not samples or years.
projects.mvp: Named-water profiles, regional lists and explained dated quality categories. No live safety or amenity claims.
projects.monetization_hypothesis: Clearly labelled tourism or accommodation referrals and contextual outdoor offers; no partnership verified.
limitations: 2291 is the official country stock, not our imported spreadsheet row count.
The documented classification is historical, not today's bathing permission or water safety.
Parking, toilets, dogs and opening hours need independent sources.
Seasonal demand; October launch is not a promise of immediate summer traffic.

projects.name: Musees de France: Museumsverzeichnis

source_count.scope: Musees de France recorded in Museofile; not all museums worldwide

projects.deduplication: One profile per REF; check renamed, closed and differently located institutions before visitor-facing publication.
projects.mvp: Museum profiles with collection themes, regional navigation and source-backed original summaries; no booking system.
projects.monetization_hypothesis: Ticket or accommodation referrals where an actual suitable programme exists; sponsorship clearly separated from descriptions.
limitations: The publisher says more than 1200, not exactly 1200.
French inventory; German-language tourist targeting does not make these German locations.
No universal verified opening-hours, ticket-price or image-rights coverage.
The older list-and-location dataset is archived; use the current Museofile release.

projects.name: Schulverzeichnis Nordrhein-Westfalen

source_count.scope: NRW public and private replacement schools, school year 2025/26; excludes supplementary and healthcare schools

projects.deduplication: Use school number; campuses, operators and annual observations remain separate concepts. Filter operating status.
projects.mvp: School-type and place navigation plus institution profiles; no rankings, admission prediction or pupil records.
projects.monetization_hypothesis: Clearly separated tutoring referrals, local sponsorship or relocation partners; payer demand unmeasured.
limitations: 5418 is official school-year population, not a counted live export.
2817 primary schools is a subset in the same report, not another independent project stock.
The daily export may have a different date and scope; reconcile during import.
No admission availability or school-quality inference from location or social indicators.

projects.name: Lebensmittelbetriebe und Hygienebewertungen Westminster

source_count.scope: Westminster XML download, all included food-business types

projects.deduplication: Use FHRSID and monitor authority changes; local business ID alone is not globally unique.
projects.mvp: Dated inspection-based profiles, business-type filters and local lists. No restaurant-taste ranking or hygiene guarantee.
projects.monetization_hypothesis: Contextual booking referrals or local sponsorship; no paid changes to official ratings.
limitations: 5779 includes shops, hotels and other food establishments, not only restaurants.
Countrywide FSA stock is broader and is not added to the Westminster subset.
Some private addresses and coordinates are withheld.
Use current rating or show update date; official logos and rating imagery have additional restrictions.
Free official search is an established competitor; no ranking advantage demonstrated.

projects.name: Forschungsnahe Organisationen Deutschland

source_count.scope: ROR API v2 default active result set, meta.countries entry id=de

projects.deduplication: Use ROR ID; filter country DE and status active in a fixed full dump. Preserve parent-child relationships rather than treating them as duplicates.
projects.mvp: Organisation profiles with place, type and official links; no automatic claim of specialist expertise or commercial availability.
projects.monetization_hypothesis: Research-partner enquiries and transparent sponsorship; lower consumer relevance, not a traffic-first favourite.
limitations: 5878 is directly observed API facet output, not a downloaded German corpus.
The global response contains mixed organisation types; these are not 5878 universities or commercial laboratories.
GeoNames locations can represent city centres, not entrances or street addresses.
Dump includes inactive and withdrawn records unless explicitly filtered.
Use a full release for exhaustive country selection; filter-only pagination can miss or repeat records.

projects.name: Historischer Denkmalatlas Frankreich

source_count.scope: Protected immovable properties in France as of 2024-01-01; historical scope, not current CSV rows

projects.deduplication: Use reference and ensemble relationships; distinguish protection acts, parts, sites and historical status.
projects.mvp: Historical and architectural profiles by place and period, not a claim that all monuments are publicly visitable.
projects.monetization_hypothesis: Tour and accommodation referrals or cultural sponsorship where relevant; no partner contracts verified.
limitations: 45080 is a dated protected-property statistic, not a live count of records or open visitor attractions.
The current dataset includes formerly protected properties; scope must not be silently narrowed to currently protected only.
Some records lack coordinates; private properties may not be accessible.
Images need separate rights review; translation and editorial checking add effort.
